portInfo.description: The lower town’s Venetian and neoclassical layers make a rewarding circuit around Syntagma Square. Palamidi rises above it; Akronafplia is a separate peninsula/fortification; Bourtzi sits on an islet. The archaeological, war and komboloi museums offer genuinely different indoor subjects rather than several names for one site.

climate.description: Mediterranean climate with hot, dry summers and mild winters

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.distanceToCity: Budget 45 minutes from ship release through the assigned berth/tender landing to Syntagma Square; 45–60 minutes on the return accommodates tender waiting if used. For Palamidi, use a retained/confirmed road pickup rather than assuming every visitor can climb the stair route. A Bourtzi boat needs its own schedule and return and is not included by default.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Palamidi fortress — Palamidi hill above Nafplio. A strenuous fortress visit; road approach and site opening must be checked. Allow 90 minutes; official source.
Akronafplia — Fortified peninsula above Nafplio old town. A separate elevated walk, not another name for Palamidi. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
Bourtzi fortress — Agioi Theodoroi islet off Nafplio. View from shore or visit only with a separately confirmed boat return. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
Archaeological Museum — West side of Syntagma Square, Nafplio. Housed in the Venetian former naval storehouse; Dendra armour is a noted collection highlight. Allow 90 minutes; official source.
War Museum — Nafplio branch — 22 Vasilissis Amalias Avenue, Nafplio. A distinct museum of modern military history; current opening not assumed. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Ask whether “terminal” on the ship’s instruction means an actual passenger building or only the assigned quay. The sources disagree on the building’s existence; neither provides a verified door.
